We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get 13C NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons count (number of signals in aromatic region ~110-160 ppm). Could also use HSQC but maybe carbon NMR enough.

We need to minimize cost. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get 13C NMR. Then count aromatic carbon signals.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
